title: Narra 4.1.9
message: A faster, richer release for anime, Asian Drama, audiobooks, and your library.
changelog: Anime keeps all native servers and adds Kuro plus direct Miruro sources, with automatic recovery when a stream fails.
Asian Drama has a proper landscape player, server switching, subtitles, saved episode progress, and live Discover and Library catalogs.
Audiobook discovery starts at the newest page, mixes multiple direct sources, and no longer waits indefinitely on a slow provider.
Discover loads only the active catalog, reducing startup traffic and making category switching smoother.
The installed APK, Profile page, and updater now agree on build 15.
